stories.title: Ex-Cowboy Dez Bryant calls out police investigation after he's cited for assault
stories.summary: Dez Bryant is calling for a thorough investigation by the Southlake Police Department of an incident that resulted in him receiving a citation for assault.
stories.detail: Former Dallas Cowboys wide receiver Dez Bryant is calling for a thorough investigation by the Southlake (Texas) Police Department of an incident on Sunday that resulted in him receiving a citation for assault. Bryant, 37, told Outkick that he confronted two drivers in a parking lot of a Mexican restaurant after they allegedly cut him off in traffic Sunday. He told the media outlet that he wanted to tell them to drive safer, but when an argument ensued with one of the men, who Bryant described as a young adult, that driver insinuated that "he'll shoot me or whatever." Bryant told Outkick that he told the man that if he pulled out a gun, "you better use it because if you don't, I'm going to do something to you." Bryant, however, said the man never pulled out a weapon and instead took out his cell phone to record him. Bryant proceeded to knock the phone out of the man's hand. The man then called police, which Bryant said he encouraged because he believed they would investigate the alleged threat against him. stories.title: Ravens' Jesse Minter optimistic QB Lamar Jackson can return vs. Bills
stories.summary: Ravens coach Jesse Minter expressed optimism Monday that quarterback Lamar Jackson could be available for Sunday's game against the Bills.
stories.detail: OWINGS MILLS, Md. -- Baltimore Ravens coach Jesse Minter expressed optimism about quarterback Lamar Jackson 's availability this week but was not definitive on whether the two-time NFL Most Valuable Player will start in Sunday's critical game at the Buffalo Bills . Jackson has missed the past three games with a high ankle sprain, including Sunday's 35-13 loss to the Cincinnati Bengals . "I think he was able to get in a little bit of work obviously towards the end of last week," Minter said Monday. "And so I think he'll be in a decent spot, but we'll know a lot more on Wednesday." Jackson seemed to be trending toward playing last week when he was a limited participant in every practice. Then, a day after being listed as questionable, Jackson was ruled out by Baltimore. Minter declined to confirm a report on the CBS game broadcast that Jackson woke up Saturday with increased swelling in his injured left ankle, which led to him being scratched. "So look, if he's able to play -- that's healthy enough to play and play the way that obviously we feel like he needs to play -- then he will play," Minter said. stories.title: Andrew Berry: We're excited to keep Maliek Collins in Cleveland
stories.summary: The 5-3 Browns have another reason to celebrate on Monday.
stories.detail: The 5-3 Browns have another reason to celebrate on Monday. Cleveland announced that defensive tackle Maliek Colins has signed his two-year contract extension with the club. The deal was agreed to over the weekend . "Since we signed Maliek in the 2025 offseason, he has been a disruptive player in the middle of our defense and one of the top interior pass rushers in football ," Browns General Manager Andrew Berry said in a statement. "His non-stop motor, selflessness and endless pass rush arsenal make him a perfect fit for our attack-style defense. As much as he has contributed to our defensive success on the field, the things he does behind the scenes are just as impactful. “For the past two years, Maliek has been THE veteran, stabilizing presence in the meeting rooms, on the practice field and in the facility. His impact on our young defensive line's growth can't be overstated. We're excited to keep Maliek in Cleveland for several more years.” Collins registered a career-high 6.5 sacks in 12 games with the Browns last season. stories.title: Browns activate Gabriel off IR, now have 4 QBs on roster
stories.summary: The Browns activated quarterback Dillon Gabriel off injured reserve Monday, giving the team four passers on the 53-man roster.
stories.detail: BEREA, Ohio -- The Cleveland Browns activated quarterback Dillon Gabriel off injured reserve Monday, giving the team four quarterbacks on the 53-man roster. Gabriel, a 2025 third-round pick, was placed on IR with a back injury at the roster cutdown deadline in late August. He was designated to return to practice Oct. 6 and will now join Deshaun Watson , Shedeur Sanders and rookie Taylen Green on the active roster. Gabriel, who played in 10 career games with six starts as a rookie, has completed 110 of 185 passes for 937 yards with seven touchdowns. Watson, who won the quarterback competition in training camp, has started the first seven games for the AFC North-leading Browns (5-2), while Sanders has served as the backup. Green, a sixth-round pick, has been the emergency QB on game days.

stories.title: John Harbaugh blasts NFL for flag on Cam Skattebo for lowing his helmet: 'That's the way you're supposed to run'
stories.summary: In a game where violence is the point, the NFL has yet to come up with a satisfactory player safety measure that doesn't legislate the football out of football.
stories.detail: During Sunday's game against the Houston Texans, New York Giants running back Cam Skattebo did what so many hard NFL runners have done before. He took a handoff, burst through a hole and lowered his helmet into an oncoming defender at the second level. The immediate result was a crunching collision, a 7-yard gain and Texans safety M.J. Stewart left reeling on his back. It was an Oklahoma drill in real game action, and Skattebo got the best of it. Holy Cam Skattebo! 🚛 pic.twitter.com/8p0gsxaukg — ΛWTHΞИƬIK (@awthentik) October 25, 2026 But the functional result of the play was not a 7-yard gain for New York. Instead of second-and-3 at the 30-yard line, the Giants were moved back half the distance to the goal for first-and-20 at their their own 13. Skattebo got flagged for unnecessary roughness because he lowered the crown of his helmet directly into Stewart. Skattebo was incensed. As was Giants head coach John Harbaugh, who gave an official an earful on the sideline. 'That's how your'e supposed to run' On Monday, Harbaugh expounded on his thoughts on the penalty, a day after New York's 27-21 win. "Did you see me after the play expressing my opinion? teamStories.summary: Klint Kubiak announced his plans to stick with Kirk Cousins as the starter for Week 8, shutting the door on any quarterback controversy.
teamStories.detail: Kirk Cousins is here to stay. The Las Vegas Raiders appeared to have somewhat of a quarterback controversy on their hands heading into Week 8. In the midst of a four-game losing streak, Vegas could've opted to turn to the No. 1 pick in the 2026 NFL Draft, Fernando Mendoza , as the starter going forward. Mendoza's time will have to wait for now. Head coach Klint Kubiak shut the door and left no doubt about the starting quarterback job when he met with reporters on Oct. 26. "Kirk is our starting quarterback," Kubiak said. "There is no controversy there. He is playing at a very high level and he's gotta continue to do that for us to win." It was a decision that came not even 24 hours after Kubiak opened the door for some debate about who would line up under center. "I think at this point, we’re thinking about everything," Kubiak told reporters, via Vegas Sports Today, after the Raiders lost to the Los Angeles Rams 35-21 on Sunday, Oct. 25. "How to fix our problems, how to fix our issues in the red zone, in the third quarter. Personnel, scheme, we’ve got to talk about all of it." However, the timing wasn't right to make the switch. teamStories.title: How active NFL players continue to redefine all-time sack list
teamStories.summary: Myles Garrett's torrid pace up the all-time sack list paces active players making their moves among the greats.
teamStories.detail: Last season, defensive end Myles Garrett won his second Defensive Player of the Year award after setting the NFL's single-season record with 23 sacks with the Cleveland Browns . This season, he'll continue his climb up the NFL's all-time sack list as a member of the Los Angeles Rams after a blockbuster trade in June -- making the Rams favorites to win the Super Bowl, according to DraftKings Sportsbook, heading into the season. Garrett entered the season with 125.5 career sacks, which was tied for 20th in NFL history and third among the other six active players -- Von Miller (No. 9), Cameron Jordan (No. 17), Calais Campbell (No. 25), T.J. Watt (No. 26), Danielle Hunter (tied for No. 27) and Khalil Mack (T-29th) -- in the top 30. Joining the top 30 soon could be Aaron Donald , who unretired to join Garrett on the Rams' defensive line. Donald's 111 sacks currently sits two behind 30th. As for Garrett, he entered his 10th season in the NFL averaging approximately 14 sacks per season. If he were to replicate that production, he would tie Pro Football Hall of Famer Jason Taylor, who currently sits at No. 7. teamStories.title: Kirk Cousins to remain Raiders' starting QB vs. Jets, Klint Kubiak says
teamStories.summary: Kirk Cousins will remain the Raiders' starting quarterback for Sunday's game against the Jets, coach Klint Kubiak announced Monday.
teamStories.detail: HENDERSON, Nev. -- Kirk Cousins will remain the Las Vegas Raiders ' starting quarterback for this Sunday's road matchup against the New York Jets , and "there's no controversy" about sitting the 38-year-old veteran for No. 1 pick Fernando Mendoza , coach Klint Kubiak said Monday. "[Cousins is] playing at a very high level, and he's got to continue to do that for us to win," Kubiak said. "We got to keep helping all the areas around him. [I'm] excited for him to go play against the Jets." Cousins' job security appeared to be in question when Kubiak said he would evaluate "everything," including the quarterback position, after the Raiders' 35-21 loss to the Los Angeles Rams on Sunday, which extended their losing streak to four games and dropped their record to 3-4. Cousins has been the least of the Raiders' troubles during their losing streak. He leads the NFL in touchdown passes (16) and is third in passing yards (1,877). Cousins overcame a shaky first-half performance against the Rams and finished with 295 passing yards and two touchdowns. He had a 59.1% completion rate and a passer rating of 94.4. stories.summary: The NBA Rookie of the Year was listed as questionable on the injury report until participating in the Mavericks' shootaround earlier on Monday.
stories.detail: Dallas Mavericks forward Cooper Flagg has been upgraded to probable on the NBA injury report for Monday's matchup with the Miami Heat. Flagg was listed as questionable prior to the injury report released at 1 p.m. ET with a left shoulder sprain. His status was then changed to probable, likely after the second-year star participated in the Mavericks' shootaround. Cooper Flagg upgraded to probable after shootaround. pic.twitter.com/Bb7jb2TZSt — Eddie Sefko (@ESefko) October 26, 2026 The second-year star sustained a sprained left shoulder during Friday's 121-105 win over the Indiana Pacers after taking a hard foul from Aaron Nesmith as he drove to the basket. Flagg landed awkwardly on his left arm and Nesmith was called for a flagrant foul. Flagg stayed in the game to hit two free throws after the foul, but subsequently went to the locker room and did not return for the remainder of the game with what the team termed a mild shoulder sprain. He finished with 14 points, 5 rebounds, 6 assists, 3 steals and 1 block in 17 minutes. With the Mavericks scheduled for back-to-back games, Flagg sat out Saturday's 122-106 loss to the San Antonio Spurs . Originally, the team said he would be re-e…

stories.title: Dream, Valkyries to play Game 6, WNBA Finals at State Farm as Thursday matinee
stories.summary: Game 6 of the WNBA Finals will be played Thursday at 12:30 p.m. ET at State Farm Arena in Atlanta. The start time of Cavs-Hawks will be pushed back to 8 p.m. ET.
stories.detail: After a weekend of nonstop frantic discussions and negotiation, Game 6 of the WNBA Finals will be played Thursday at 12:30 p.m. ET at 17,000-seat State Farm Arena in Atlanta. The Atlanta Hawks - Cleveland Cavaliers game that night will move to 8:00 p.m. ET to accommodate the doubleheader, just as the Hawks did for Game 4. This allows a potential Game 7 to remain scheduled for Halloween at Chase Center in San Francisco. All three Finals games in Atlanta have required hurried adjustments to the schedule at State Farm Arena. It took collective efforts from the WNBA, NBA, the Hawks, State Farm Arena, Dream , Valkyries and broadcast partners to figure out the best course of action again. By moving the game earlier in the day, the WNBA avoided a scenario where a potential championship game was played inside the Dream's home arena, the 3,500-seat Gateway Center. The other option under strong consideration was moving Game 6 to an open date at State Farm Arena on Friday and Game 7 to an open date at Chase Center on Tuesday, Nov. 3.

stories.detail: The Dallas Mavericks are in Miami playing their old rivals, the Heat, as they look for their second win of the year. Miami made a huge splash over the offseason trading for Giannis Antetokounmpo, but have not seen the fruits of their labor thus far. They have yet to win, but despite their hunger, the Mavericks are not going to go down easily. With Cooper Flagg looking good to go, Dallas can catch Miami with their pants down if they make shots early. Given the Mavericks’ center rotation, this will be Dusty May’s first true test of how he can scheme a win. It should be a chess match against one of the NBA’s longest-tenured coaches, Erik Spoelstra.
